# Mapscaping

> A comprehensive geospatial podcast and interactive mapping tools platform covering GIS, QGIS, open-source technology, and AI integration in mapping.

Mapscaping combines the MapScaping Podcast—hosted by Daniel O'Donohue—with a suite of free, browser-based geospatial tools for data conversion, visualization, and analysis. The site serves the geospatial community with discussions on QGIS, open-source sustainability, and emerging technologies like AI and drone mapping.

## Key Topics

- QGIS
- Geospatial Technology
- Open Source GIS
- Podcast
- GeoJSON
- KML
- AI Integration
- Map Tools
- Geospatial Data
- Large Language Models
- Earth Observation
- FOSS4G
- Discrete Global Grid Systems
- Drone Mapping
- Geospatial Entrepreneurship

## Podcast Episodes

- [The MapScaping Podcast](https://mapscaping.com/podcasts): MapScaping Podcast main page with geospatial episodes and discussions
- [AI In QGIS](https://mapscaping.com/podcast/ai-in-qgis): Podcast episode exploring AI integration and LLMs in QGIS
- [Mapping Your Own World: Open Drones And Localized AI](https://mapscaping.com/podcast/mapping-your-own-world-open-drones-and-localized-ai): Podcast episode on community mapping with drones and localized AI models
- [Geospatial Makers Start Building!](https://mapscaping.com/podcast/geospatial-makers-start-buildng): Podcast episode on geospatial product development and entrepreneurship
- [A5 Pentagons Are The New Bestagons](https://mapscaping.com/podcast/a5-pentagons-are-the-new-bestagons): Podcast episode on discrete global grid systems and spatial indexing
- [The Sustainable Path For Open Source Businesses](https://mapscaping.com/podcast/the-sustainable-path-for-open-source-businesses): Podcast episode on sustainable business models for open-source projects
- [Vibe Coding And The Fragmentation Of Open Source](https://mapscaping.com/podcast/vibe-coding-and-the-fragmentation-of-open-source): Podcast episode on AI coding and open-source fragmentation in geospatial
- [Free Software And Expensive Threats](https://mapscaping.com/podcast/free-software-and-expensive-threats): Podcast episode on open-source security vulnerabilities and sustainability

## Interactive Mapping Tools

- [Map Tools](https://mapscaping.com/map-tools): Collection of free geospatial map tools and converters
- [Graduated Symbol Map Maker](https://mapscaping.com/graduated-symbol-map-maker): Interactive tool to create graduated symbol maps from CSV, GeoJSON, KML, GPX
- [GeoJSON And KML Merger](https://mapscaping.com/geojson-and-kml-merger): Online tool to merge multiple GeoJSON and KML files without software
- [How Many Football Fields? Interactive Area Calculator Map](https://mapscaping.com/how-many-football-fields): Free interactive area calculator for land measurement in multiple units

## Core

- [Home - Mapscaping.com](https://mapscaping.com): Mapscaping podcast homepage featuring geospatial and QGIS content
